The tournament was named in commemoration of the 200th anniversary of the [[Independence of Argentina]]. The season began on 26 August 2016 and ended on 27 June 2017.{{cite web|url=http://www.afa.org.ar/upload/reglamento/191RADIVISION%202016-2017largo.pdf |title=Reglamento del Campeonato de Primera División 2016–17|access-date=24 August 2016|publisher=AFA |language=es}} Thirty teams competed in the league, twenty-nine returning from the [[2016 Argentine Primera División|2016]] season, and the addition of [[Talleres de Córdoba]] as the [[Primera B Nacional]] champion. [[Argentinos Juniors]] did not take part having been relegated the previous season. [[Boca Juniors]] were crowned champions of Argentina for a 32nd time after rivals Banfield were beaten by San Lorenzo on 20 June 2017. As a result, Boca Juniors qualified for the [[2018 Copa Libertadores]] and the [[2017 Supercopa Argentina]].{{cite web |url=http://www.lanacion.com.ar/2035069-san-lorenzo-banfield-torneo-primera-division-fecha-29 |title=San Lorenzo-Banfield, Torneo Primera División: perdió el Taladro y Boca salió campeón |date=30 June 2017 |publisher=La Nación |language=es |access-date=30 June 2017 |archive-date=1 November 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171101114019/http://www.lanacion.com.ar/2035069-san-lorenzo-banfield-torneo-primera-division-fecha-29 |url-status=dead }} == Competition format == The tournament for the 2016 season was composed of 30 teams.
